exctecled.msg: Leading advertising screen distribution in Peru across fixed, rental, and stadium segments is a wide range to manage. Stadium LED is its own spec challenge — refresh rates for broadcast, sun angle variance, viewing distance across different seat tiers. What has been driving the most inquiries lately, fixed outdoor or stadium projects?

gtledpainel.msg: Full AV rental — LED, video, audio, lighting all in one operation for rodeos and major events is a serious logistics commitment across Brazil. 15 years in that market means you have seen a lot of panel generations. What pitch are you running for your main outdoor stage setups now, and have you moved toward lighter cabinet systems for the long-haul events?

azkareventos.msg: LED giant screens for corporate events and major productions in Bogotá is a high-stakes segment — everything has to work, on time, at spec. We are on the manufacturing side in Shenzhen. For the large-format event setups, what cabinet system are you running — and do you own your inventory or source per-project for the bigger installs?

Agsled.msg: LED screen rental in Concepción puts you in a market that is a bit more contained than Santiago — curious how that shapes your fleet. Are most of your events outdoor stages or indoor venues? And what pixel pitch is your main workhorse panel for events in the region?
